profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer / Architect @ Clear Launch | Full-Stack Development, TypeScript, Software Architecture
profile.summary:
I’m a senior developer/architect who bridges technical execution with business outcomes. For 20+ years I’ve worked directly with clients and leadership to translate goals and constraints into software that ships—and keeps working. I’m often brought in for rebuilds, migrations, and “make this reliable” situations where clarity, pragmatism, and follow-through matter.

Recent work includes stabilizing a real estate sales analytics platform, rebuilding a student planning and progress-tracking system after a failed internal attempt, revamping a mobile shopping-cart experience to improve purchase flow, and rebuilding an Indiana University analytics dashboard later recognized with an Ed-Fi “Award of the Year.”

My core strengths are TypeScript/JavaScript, C#/.NET, data systems, integrations, and designing approaches that reduce risk while moving fast. I enjoy mentoring and raising engineering standards through collaboration, transparency, and grounded technical reasoning.

I’m optimistic about AI in software development: it can dramatically accelerate delivery and learning when used with focus, strong review discipline, and accountability for correctness.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer / Architect
positions.description:
RealSynch (Turnaround): Led development of a real estate sales data & analytics platform aggregating multiple sources, tracking prospecting and deal stages, and delivering dashboard insights—helping turn an unreliable product into a stable, sellable offering.

Tiff’s Treats (Core platform + mobile cart revamp): Developed and maintained core sales/order system features; led a mobile UI redesign by rebuilding the shopping cart to improve the mobile purchase flow.

Future Forward (Greenfield rebuild): Rebuilt the platform from scratch after an unsuccessful internal attempt; delivered a student planning and progress-tracking system with parent engagement plus reading/objective tracking (now part of Springboard Collaborative).

InDash — Indiana University (Rebuild + award): Rebuilt InDash, an analytics dashboard based on location data; project received Ed-Fi “Award of the Year” recognition at the Ed-Fi conference.

BuildASign (Shipping workflow): Streamlined shipping operations by implementing multi-package delivery support across carriers, including shipping label generation and multi-delivery handling.
positions.insights: Stored procedures and query tuning, Git, GitHub, DevOps, CI/CD and +29 skills

positions.title: Senior Developer
positions.locationName: The National Alliance for Insurance Education, Austin, Texas
positions.description:
Made major improvements to the company’s information systems including finance, academic support, attendance management and course conduct. Coordinated with top management, outside groups, and IT personnel to make significant system changes to support important process improvement efforts. This work created sustained productivity gains that have enabled the company to grow on revenue without incurring new hiring expenses. Achieved much better service for our customers. 

Designed, implemented and maintained the following systems: Automated education credit system, Integration with LMS, Electronic CE filing, Custom budgeting system, Shopping cart customization and integration, Document archival system (10+ million documents), Custom task management, Custom ordering system and Education credit system; Using Oracle RDBMS, C# and Omnis 7(Legacy) as our technology base.
positions.insights: Stored procedures and query tuning, Git, GitHub, DevOps, CI/CD and +8 skills

positions.title: Lead Programmer / Project Manager
positions.description:
Developed the sales compensation system for Williams Telecommunications. This software supported 40 different contractual compensation mechanisms and resolved significant difficulties with their previous system. The project included safe migration of existing data using Omnis 7 as the client and Oracle on the backend. As a result, our client requested my services for a new sales compensation system with renewed success.

Developed and led a new general administration system for The National Alliance for Insurance Education and Research. Rescued a failing project and transformed it to a successful implementation.  Resolved the previous system’s Y2K compliance problems. Built a semi-automatic migration tool for a general accounting system from a proprietary database technology to an Oracle database. Managed communication between the customer and programmers, prioritizing and balancing expectations.
positions.insights: Stored procedures and query tuning, SQL Server / Oracle database maintenance and +1 skill
